description.en: Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness: 77 dictionaries / 4,253 strings regenerated for DSH 0.2.2-rc.3, scoped Korean font stack, marketplace-ready.
description.ko: 딥시크 하네스 한국어 언어팩: DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 기준 77개 사전 / 4,253개 문자열, 한국어 전용 폰트 스택, 마켓 등록 지원.

release.notes: v0.0.1-rc.4 regenerates the pack against DSH 0.2.2-rc.3: 77 dictionaries / 4,253 strings, 0 missing, 0 extra and 0 placeholder mismatches against the installed runtime (five of the namespaces are registered with variable or three-argument payloads that a naive parser reports as retired). Korean wording was reviewed by Gemini 4 Hydrogen; the EXAONE comparison route was unavailable (429 rate limit). English README.md remains the default document with a reciprocal Korean README.ko.md; CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.ko.md record the version history.
